 Order

This Writ Petition was filed seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, rd Order or direction declaring the action of 3 respondent in summoning the petitioners to the Police Station and detaining them for hours at the th behest of 4 respondent in respect of a civil dispute as illegal, arbitrary and ultra vires of his powers apart from violation of Articles 14 and 21 of rd the Constitution of India and consequently, direct 3 respondent from nd interfering with the petitioners' life and liberty and further,
direct 2 st respondent to act upon the complaint dated 20.09.2021 of 1 petitioner and to pass such other order ..."
2.

It is the case of Writ Petitioners that 3rd respondent-police was harassing the Writ Petitioners by calling them to the police station at the instance of 4th respondent and forcing them to compromise a contractual/civil dispute with 4th respondent under the threat of arrest, which amounts to interference with the life and liberty of the Writ Petitioners.
3. sentences.text: It is only in connection with investigation in the said crime, the Writ Petitioners were called to the police station at that time.

Subsequently, the police concluded the investigation and filed Charge SRK, J Sheet vide C.F.No.12025, dated 29.12.2025 before the Jurisdictional Magistrate Court at Machilipatnam and the same is pending for taking cognizance of the case.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home would further submit that except registration of Crime No.191 of 2021 and filing charge sheet, police were not interfering in the civil disputes between the Writ Petitioners and 4th respondent.
4. Recording the same, Writ Petition is closed.
There shall be no order as to costs of the Writ Petition.

As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
___ __________ JUSTICE K. SREENIVASA REDDY 31st March, 2026.
